title: Portal Gateway: Lens-based Workspace Switchboard and Compact Rail
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: the current console navigation mixes global routes, workspace content, and transient controls (dashboards, rollouts, cost breakdowns) in ways that make task switching noisy for power users and confusing for new users. Goal: design an information architecture that separates global controls (account, org-level settings), workspace-level context, and ephemeral lenses (dashboards, rollout monitors, cost views) with minimal cognitive overhead.

Proposal summary: introduce a compact left rail that surfaces high-level workspace switching plus a persistent "Lens Switchboard" — a micro-pane that opens from the rail to present contextual lenses (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost Insights, Logs) for the selected workspace. Lenses are shallow, task-focused surfaces overlaying the main canvas (not full route changes) to preserve user context. Workspaces are discoverable via a dedicated workspace picker and quick keyboard command.

Design trade-offs considered:
- Rail density vs discoverability: denser rail shows more icons but increases visual noise. Decided to default to compact icons with hover-expanded labels to balance screen real estate for heavy ML dashboards.
- Lenses as overlays vs full routes: overlays keep context and reduce route churn, but break deep-linking. Compromise: lenses support deep-linkable query params and a lightweight routing fallback that can surface a full page when necessary (e.g., shared permalink to a cost report).
- Workspace switching friction: adding a lightweight recent-workspaces row and keyboard shortcut to minimize context switching time.

Accessibility: all rail items, lens controls, and workspace picker will be keyboard navigable and ARIA-labeled. Color contrast for cost heatmaps will be verified against WCAG AA.

Success metrics (measured post-launch): average task switch time (goal: -20%), increase in adoption of Lens surfaces for first-time users (+15% discoverability), reduction in "Where is my cost breakdown?" support tickets (-30%).

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Compact left rail renders on small screens and collapses correctly at 1024px width and below
Lens Switchboard opens within 200ms of click/keyboard activation on typical load (hosted API region us-west-2)
Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost Insights lenses respect workspace scoping and show workspace-level data without a full page navigation
Each lens has a deep-link URL pattern that can be shared and restores state (filters/date range)
Keyboard flow: Cmd/Ctrl+K to open command palette, type 'switch workspace' or 'open cost lens' and land in correct lens
Accessibility: all interactive elements pass keyboard focus order and have ARIA labels; color contrast >= AA for key indicators
